rows.description: If the wearer is a bard, he is considered 5 class levels higher for purposes of his bardic knowledge class feature, bonuses granted by inspire courage and inspire competence are increased by 1, and can take 10 on any Perform skill check he has ranks in.

rows.name: Key Cloak
rows.description: As a move action, the wearer can activate a dome-shaped shield, protecting the wearer as if he were carrying a tower shield with which he is proficient. While using this ability, the wearer can take no other actions and is immobile.

rows.name: Saliharion
rows.description: [redacted PI]

rows.name: Scabbard of the Lost Kiss
rows.description: [redacted PI]

rows.name: Thundering Collar
rows.description: Wearer can issue a growl like rolling thunder three times per day. Creatures within 15 feet must succeed at a DC 12 Will save to attack (as sanctuary). The wielder can bestow the effect on one adjacent ally as well. This effect lasts for 3 rounds or until the wearer or its ally attacks.

rows.name: Fist of the Pit
rows.description: Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can strike the ground with the gauntlet, causing a 10-foot-square, 30-foot-deep extradimensional pit filled with spikes to open within 30 feet, as per spiked pit (APG). Any enhancement bonus or weapon special abilities that deal extra damage is added to the damage caused by the pit's spikes.

rows.name: Censuring Placard
rows.description: As a swift action with a successful melee attack, the wielder can use the placard to cast break enchantment on that target. Whether this effort is successful or not, the break enchantment ability cannot be used again for a week.

rows.name: Mace of Keys
rows.description: Three times per day, upon a successful melee attack, the wielder can attempt a combat maneuver check to cause an item on the target in the belt, shoulder, or neck slot to come loose and fall to the ground in the target's space. When attempting to destroy a lock, the mace ignores up to 20 points of the lock's hardness.

rows.name: Vaultbow
rows.description: Holds an extra 20 bolts. 3/day, can fire entangling chain.

rows.name: Nightpiercer
rows.description: Applies the ghost touch weapon special ability to all bolts fired from it. If a bolt deals damage to an incorporeal undead creature, the bolt remains embedded in the creature, reducing all of the target's speeds by half (to a minimum of 5 feet) for 1 round.

rows.name: Sunlord's Feather
rows.description: When the arrow strikes an evil-aligned creature, it summons a swarm of celestial doves (treat as a celestial bat swarm; Bestiary 294, 30) that continues to attack the arrow's target for 10 rounds.

rows.name: Hateful Sting
rows.description: Can attack foes up to 60 feet from the activating character, can store up to 4 doses of poison, which it can apply to itself automatically.

rows.name: Raiment of Chains
rows.description: The wearer can don or remove the armor as a move action. Three times per day as a standard action, the wearer can command chains to shoot out from the raiment of chains and attempt a reposition or trip combat maneuver check against a single target within 20 feet. The wearer is considered proficient with the chains and uses her own CMB with a +1 enhancement bonus on the check. The combat maneuver provokes attacks of opportunity as normal. The chains immediately retract back into the armor once the combat maneuver check has been attempted.

rows.name: Clay Whippoorwill
rows.description: Doubles range of secret Nightsong language

rows.name: Soul Candle
rows.description: Goes out when within 5 feet of a haunt or undead.
